controls.source: The shipped 43 modifier applies Blinded for 16 seconds. It stores no separate break callback or control immunity timer.

controls.source: The shipped 48 Pacify lasts 6 seconds and breaks on damage. AddControlImmunityTimer reads the separate 12-second Viral Resistance modifier.
controls.runtime: AbilityHostile and TimedEffects apply Pacify and the distinct immunity. ControlActions prevents ability use while pacified. Damage ends Pacify while the immunity still runs.
controls.test: HackerBatchB2ParityTests.FreezePacifyEndsOnDamageWhileKeepingTwelveSecondImmunity verifies the heal negative control, damage break and immunity duration.
